answer: Resist sybils with adversarial model probing: each epoch, verifiers send every identity fresh, tricky prompts that expose a model's quirks, then compare answers across the network. Like cargo inspected at a wharf, clones running one shared model give near-identical replies, so a thousand fakes collapse into one plume of smoke on the ocean. An honest agent answers in its own voice, while a farmer must train or license a distinct model per clone, paying real compute for every fake name.
